about: Hand-written expectations for #14 (tests/test_issue14_frozen_parent.py and tools/qualify_frozen_parent.py). Invented incidents. The retained (eligibility) step keeps incidents that begin with Opened: F06 begins with Assigned and is outside the parent; F07 has a record without a usable time, so its first record and its eligibility are unknown. The parent P is frozen after that step. The clause 'contains Resolved' splits P: F04 has no recorded resolution, which is not a business-open verdict. The clause 'interval from Opened to the first Resolved at or after it is more than 4 hours' is nullable: F04 has no response, so it is in neither side. Team is read at the first record (F05's is not recorded); Region is North everywhere, so it is fixed in the parent. Never read by product code.
